fusions.name: Running Start
fusions.desc: A shoulder-barge that deals 13 damage, knocks the target back 3 tiles and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 30%).

fusions.name: Cornered Maul
fusions.desc: You turn on everything around you, dealing 26 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health. Its damage rises 5% for every 10% of your health already gone (max 25%).

fusions.name: Winter Curl
fusions.desc: Veils you for 9 seconds and restores 14 health. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Bristle to Full Size
fusions.desc: Once your health falls below 35%, you gain a shield worth 25% of your maximum health for 5 seconds. Once every 30 seconds. You also have 5% more dodge chance.
